description: Where each course and lesson card thumbnail comes from. scripts/build_thumbnails.py reads this and writes the square WebP files beside it. Crop boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the source. Manual and book pages are read from the Notes folder (--notes); renders live in scripts/thumbnail_sources and were captured from the app's own 3D viewer with scripts/capture_model_thumbnail.js. The 'previews' section builds the Explore gallery card images (web/model-previews/<model id>.webp) the same way. The 'banners' section builds the wide course-header images (web/banners/<pack id>.webp, 2:1) the same way; its renders are 1000 x 500 captures (scripts/thumbnail_sources/banner-*.webp), and a 'shift' of [dx, dy] pixels places a subject off-centre.
